q2_gaps: decomposition of a PARTICIPIAL / adjectival compound ("salt-bloomed"): the genus rule is specified for modifier_noun compounds whose last word is a real head noun, and adjective compounds are explicitly told to be left opaque, so nothing licenses or forbids (Inheritance salt_bloomed bloomed)
a compound kind whose MODIFIER is itself multi-word ("cold-threshold night"): "decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop" says nothing about the two-word modifier that stays inside the symbol
notes: A witness rather than a generic for the indefinite subject is exactly what the Existential section mandates with a verbal predicate, even though the sentence reads as a world rule. Agent/Theme for survive (no possession or stative-psych demotion), splitting the descriptive modifier into its own Member atom, the cold_threshold_night fusion with genus night and no exposed modifier, and the absent status atom all conform.
